description: Land Title Settlement Department - Balagalla, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510006
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land ownership information, property descriptions, and legal determinations about land titles, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
